digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend comment sanitizer
propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling at 32767 characters, ignoring Jira Data Center's admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit property which ranges 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647
when a DC admin raises or removes the character limit, rebar silently truncates comments that the instance would accept, causing permanent divergence between local and remote bodies
the 32767 default is correct for stock Jira 7.0+ but wrong for configured instances, creating a data-loss window for operators who raised the limit
comment sanitization incorrectly reuses the description fitter (fit_outbound), coupling comment truncation to description logic where future changes could silently retarget both

the endpoint /rest/api/2/application-properties/advanced-settings that exposes jira.text.field.character.limit requires admin permission and is unreadable by rebar's ordinary-user PAT, making auto-discovery infeasible
